methods.method_description: Dismiss any open Windows overlays (Start menu, search box)
methods.method_purpose: Checks the toggle state of Windows Start menu and search bar, and closes them if they are open to prepare a clean desktop state.

methods.method_description: Clicks the Windows Start menu button
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the Start menu button to be available and clicks it to open the Start menu.

methods.method_description: Clicks the Apps button in Windows settings
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the Apps button to be available and clicks it to navigate to the Apps section.
Waits for the Installed Apps button to be available and clicks it to view installed applications.

methods.method_description: Searches for HP apps in the installed apps list
methods.method_purpose: Clicks the search bar for apps, waits for it to be available, and types 'HP' to search for HP-related applications.

methods.method_description: Verifies the HP app icon is visible in Windows settings
methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean or WebElement indicating presence of HP app icon
methods.method_purpose: Scrolls to the HP app icon element and waits for it to be visible, returning the element or verification status.

methods.method_description: Clicks the HP app icon in Windows settings
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the HP app icon to be available and clicks it to open HP app settings.

methods.method_description: Verifies the myHP app icon is present on the taskbar
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the myHP app icon to be visible on the Windows taskbar to confirm it is pinned.

methods.method_description: Clicks the Library button on Microsoft Store
methods.method_purpose: Clicks the Library button in the Microsoft Store with a 30-second timeout to access the app library.

methods.method_description: Clicks the myHP app icon on the taskbar
methods.method_purpose: Clicks the myHP app icon on the Windows taskbar to launch or bring focus to the application.
Hovers over the maximize button and waits for it to be visible, typically used to reveal window controls.

methods.method_description: Verifies myHP app is pinned to the Start menu
methods.method_purpose: Opens the Start menu, verifies the myHP app icon is present, and closes the Start menu to confirm the app is pinned.

methods.method_description: Unpins HP app from the Start menu
methods.method_purpose: Checks if the unpin option is available and clicks it to remove the HP app from the Start menu.

methods.method_description: Verifies the scroll bar is present
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the scroll bar element to be visible to confirm scrollable content is available.
Clicks the scroll bar element with a 10-second timeout to interact with scrollable content.

methods.method_description: Checks if the refresh button is disabled
methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean - True if refresh button exists, False otherwise
methods.method_purpose: Waits for the refresh button without raising an exception and returns True if found, False if not found, to determine button state.
